text: in the studio mesh editor can you make it easier to save a copy of something this is kinda a pain in the ass right now i am trying to make variations of things and i keep just overwriting the same shit
resolution: Added a 'Save a Copy' verb to the Studio mesh editor so making variations no longer overwrites the original. The Studio auto-persists every edit to the open model's branch, so there was no fork affordance — editing always wrote back into the same model. New duplicateModel() in editors/model/studioModel.ts forks a model (default: the open one) into a brand-new library model: fresh model id + fresh part ids, preserving part order, palette, and the painted texture, then opens the copy so further edits land on it. The content-addressed pixel-paint blob is shared by reference (paintRef), so nothing is re-stored. Names auto-increment ('X copy', 'X copy 2', no 'copy copy' stacking). Exposed as a hero-bar pill 'Save a Copy' (Copy icon) in the model workbench source, shown only when a model is open. Verified via SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int (bundle + native compile clean).
